techdella.help: Pulls published posts first. items (inline fallback, same shape as Case card's item) render only when the query finds nothing. industry = td_industry slug. Studios: source studio_work, variant cover. Concept items always show a Concept label. Inline items take frame (browser|phone) + site + imagePhone to show real screenshots in a CSS device frame, and note for a visible [CONFIRM].
